messages:
Emily M.: Hey team — kickstarting the PioneerGrid customer story. They agreed to a 30–40m interview next Wed 3/31 at 10am PT. Need: quote approval, legal signoff on the case excerpt, benchmark snapshot + 2 soundbites for the launch post. Who can own the interview notes and the quote approval flow?
Sam G.: I can own the launch plan and webinar tie-in. Quick Q — do we want to pair the post with the benchmark numbers we ran last quarter or keep that separate?
Marta C.: I'll take interview notes and pull the top soundbites. Will need transcript and a short list of questions beforehand. Can someone drop the recording link + sample Qs by EOD Mon? :memo:
Jordan P.: If we're including benchmarks, we should confirm the dataset & date range. PioneerGrid's throughput test was on p4.x2 last run 2026-02-12. I can pull the spreadsheet. Will also add the model/quant settings we used.
Lei (Legal): Quick flags from legal: 1) we need a signed consent for quotes (email thread is fine), 2) any customer-provided numbers must be labeled as customer-reported unless we directly validated, 3) redact PII. Send me draft copy and quote excerpts and I can review within 48h.
Emily M.: Thanks Lei. I have the consent email from their PM (copied in). I'll assemble the draft quote doc. Marta — can you run the transcript through the redaction checklist before handing to Lei?
Marta C.: Yep. Plan: record > auto-transcript > first-pass redaction > hand to Lei. ETA for transcript + first-pass redaction: Thu 3/25.
Sam G.: For the webinar: propose recording a live customer panel the week after publish. That gives sales something to route inbound leads to. Who owns the sales handoff?
Emily M.: Sam, can you coordinate with Sales Ops — I'll create the lead routing doc. Also want a short hero quote (<= 140 chars) for the social post. Marta, please flag 3 candidate soundbites.
Jordan P.: Uploaded benchmark sheet to drive: https://drive.redwood/pioneergrid/benchmarks-2026-02-12 (cols: throughput, p99, cost-per-token). Use sheet tab "public-summary" for copy-ready numbers.
Lei (Legal): FYI — if the benchmark links to specific infra configs, mark them as "test config" and avoid implying SLA for customers. Also confirm we have permission to publish screenshots of their console.
ReleaseBot: Checklist created: /marketing/case-studies/pioneergrid/checklist.md — items: consent, transcript, quote-draft, legal-review, asset-approval, publish-date. Assigned: Marta -> transcript, Emily -> quote-draft, Sam -> launch plan.
Emily M.: Great. Final asks before I schedule the interview: Marta/Jordan, please share the interview Qs (3 topical + 2 follow-ups) by EOD Mon; Lei, can you commit to a 48h turn on quote review after we drop draft?
Lei (Legal): Yes — 48h after draft lands. If there are redactions, I'll note them inline.
Marta C.: Draft Qs (first pass):
```
1) What problem did Redwood help you solve, and how did it change your daily ops?
2) Can you share a specific workload where latency/cost improved? numbers if possible.
3) What was the rollout process — any surprises?
Follow-ups: can you expand on the benchmarking setup? any third-party tools?
```
I'll refine and add conversational probes.
Sam G.: Cool — I'll start a simple Run-of-Show for the interview + webinar tie. Planning doc: https://docs.redwood/marketing/pioneergrid-runbook — will post draft by Tue. :rocket:
Emily M.: Awesome team. I'll lock interview and send calendar invites once Qs + runbook are in. Target publish window: week of 4/6. :wave:
